changes_by.chf_inflation_1_percent: the CHF long-run inflation of 1.0 % a year, the midpoint of the SNB's 0 to 2 % range, in place of the measured 0.50 % (LBS-36): every figure converted between today's francs and francs of a date moves with it
changes_by.plausibility_table_approved: the plausibility table approved by the owner unchanged (LBS-37): the source line of the ceiling says so; no ceiling moves

figures.goal_amounts: a goal's amount in the other basis and its price level (real_view.goals)
figures.inflation_assumption: the assumption itself: rate, log rate, source (real_view.inflation)
figures.plausibility: the plausibility judgement: the nominal ceiling, the real required return, the levers
figures.property: a property price stated in future francs, deflated to today
figures.required_return: the mandate's target, required return (nominal and real), curve and notes
figures.retirement: the retirement comparison in today's francs (the BVG pension deflated) and its nominal view

required_returns: required_returns.json: the designated goal's required return under 1.4.0 and 1.5.0, nominal and real, and its move in points, for every case that has one
tolerance: 1e-9 relative on every number (absolute near zero), every other leaf exactly
